correctness.rationale: For the corrected model, detailed balance reduces each edge flux to min(r_i,r_j)/2. Positive rates and single-label moves make the labelled chain irreducible in continuous time and under uniform single-label discrete updates. With heterogeneous depths the single-label attempted-move kernel is primitive, so synchronous product updates are also primitive. The separate equal-depth even-cycle cases in the repair correctly distinguish reducibility for simultaneous moves from mere periodicity for single-label updates. Gibbs partial-sum differentiation gives strict non-permutation majorization; vacancy is a strictly convex separable sum. Conditional on a pair's total R and the other counts, its Gini contribution is symmetric and discretely convex, with a positive second difference from |2t−R| whenever R≥2. Binomial averaging then gives strict pair balancing for M≥2 and positive Gibbs probabilities. In the fixed-T limit, conditional site Poisson errors are O(1/L), normalizers obey the LLN and Efron–Stein with a 2/L bounded difference controls the empirical fraction; the uniformly bounded Poisson rates give the tail bound. No uniform mixing or T→0 joint-limit conclusion follows.
